_comment: Hand-authored to preserve Bannerlord conditional placeholders. The AI translator's placeholder-integrity guard rejected its own output for these ids because the model collapsed or duplicated a {?VAR}a{?}b{\?} block; the engine needs the count to match English exactly. Where the target language has no grammatical gender, both branches carry the same word on purpose. The vanilla-derived ids that once lived here (uc4M4bhG, qa4FlTWS, uiY3ds0Z) are English-only overrides now.
